rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Demonstrates transferable adversarial attacks against LLM code-review agents.
rationale.ai-review: Empirically exposes systematic reliability limits in CoT-based vulnerability judgment.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Evaluates obfuscations evading static analyzers while preserving malicious semantics.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes claims that CoT-enhanced detectors are robust against obfuscation.
rationale.framework: Provides a reusable multi-agent obfuscation and verifier pipeline.
rationale.built-system: Implements and evaluates CoTDeceptor across models, agents, and languages.
rationale.agentic: Agents autonomously plan and evolve multi-step artifact-level code transformations.
rationale.steering: Prompts, feedback, and strategy trees shape generated obfuscations.
rationale.metrics: Defines a security-evasion score using detector inconsistency and transferability.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates concealment of security vulnerabilities across fifteen categories.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled experiments characterize third-party models' susceptibility to adversarial code.
